description.narrative: The Urban Resilience Fund (TURF) targets investments in infrastructure projects and companies that improve the urban environment and provide essential public services to local communities. Investments in countries in sub-Saharan Africa are prioritised._x000D_ _x000D_ Swedfund's investment is expected to contribute to job creation, stimulate local economic growth and improve access to basic public services._x000D_ _x000D_ The investment also contributes to meeting the challenges of climate change and urbanisation by enabling investments in micropower grids, waste management facilities and energy efficient community environments, such as street lighting and sustainable transport.
